import pandas as pd

# Read input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Get indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicators = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = df[indicators].isnull().sum()
missing_rates = df[indicators].isnull().mean()

# Create missingness report with all indicators
report_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicators,
    'missing_count': missing_counts,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates,
    'kept': missing_rates <= 0.30
})
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Filter indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = indicators[missing_rates <= 0.30]

# Write selected matrix with only kept indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
